entries.test: Compare the listed corrections and omissions with Harry Shearer's Wikipedia page as of publication, including their placement near the top of the page.
entries.note: “Two second search” plainly means readily accessible information; screen size introduces minor variability.

entries.test: Public model analyses and controlled interventions could establish whether associations between Shearer, entertainers, and British nationality caused the erroneous completion.
entries.note: The passage asserts a mechanism for this error; merely reproducing the error would not establish that mechanism.
The reported rate is factual, but judging that performance “pathetic” is a judgment of worth.

entries.test: Public architecture documentation and model studies could establish whether LLMs contain record databases or world models meeting the named researchers' published criteria.
entries.note: The attribution to particular researchers constrains the meaning of “world model”; generic uses of that term would not settle the claim.

entries.test: Public training-data documentation, legal-move evaluations, and controlled model studies could test whether chess-rule violations arise from failure to learn rule abstractions despite extensive chess training data.
entries.note: Illegal moves alone would establish the behavioral failure, not its asserted cause.

entries.test: Public evaluations of LLMs checking their own factual outputs, together with controlled studies of the representations involved, could test the asserted inability and its proposed cause.
entries.note: The surrounding passage makes this a substantive claim about capability, despite its emphatic wording.
